utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you help coordinate a few volunteers and maybe bring any spare tools you’ve got? I’m running a bit late, but I’ll catch up and pitch in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll round up a few volunteers and bring the spare tools I have. Just send me the details when you can, and I’ll keep things moving until you catch up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a screwdriver set, some zip ties, and a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring those over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive—just let me know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Cleo — I’ll check what we’re missing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll be here when you’ve got the list, and I can help gather whatever we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mainly worried about who can pick things up and where we’ll store them. If you can help sort the deliveries and keep track of the drop-off list, that would be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated. Just tell me where to start, and I’ll keep an eye on both.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, what’s the plan for the repair drive—do you need help sorting tools or handing out flyers?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, honestly. If you point me to whatever needs doing first, I can help with either.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—let’s start with the flyers, then. I’ll point you to the pile and you can help me sort them by street.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good bit of support already—folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon. If you want, I can tell you where they're setting everything up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I'd love that. I’ve got a few tools I can bring by too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Gus — they’re setting it up by the community hall near Maple Street. Bring whatever you’ve got; I’m sure it’ll be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'm spreading the word now. If you want, I can swing by and help gather a few more neighbors for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Quinn—thank you. I’m keeping track of who’s coming, so just let me know who you find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll check in with a few folks on my block and send you their names as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to make sure, you’re still good to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely—I’m still good to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive — I’ve got the sign-up sheet ready and I’m lining up the first few tasks. What part would you like to help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with the first few tasks — just point me to the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Bo — I’ll bring it over and walk you through the first few sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let people know about the repair drive and keep repeating the plan as it comes together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Keep it simple and let me know the time and place when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep it simple and pass along the time and place once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to ask about that. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you could help sort donations or carry a few things, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can do that. Just point me to where you need me, and I’ll start sorting or carrying.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and connect me with anyone who needs a fix? I’m trying to line up a few more folks for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see who in the neighborhood needs a fix. If anyone comes to mind, I’ll connect them with you right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a repair drive and thought of you right away — want to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m in — sorry I’m a bit late to this, but I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. I’ll send you the details and a simple blurb you can pass along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey—what we still need most is a few volunteers, some basic tools, and a clear time to start. If you can help with any of those, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with tools and a volunteer shift. What start time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule so we can get the repair drive sorted. What timing are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Faye — I was thinking we could aim for next Saturday morning, when most folks are free.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Next Saturday morning works for me — I’ll check the school calendar and help spread the word. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad you’re here, Vik — are you heading to the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later today and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, that’ll help a lot — if you have time, ask what tools or supplies they’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — if you need any tools for the repair drive, just let me know and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m mostly worried about getting everything there on time, so I’ll let you know what tools I’m short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just tell me what’s missing, and I can help get it there on time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive details—where’s the drop-off spot again?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s at the community center parking lot by the side entrance—just pull up there, and we’ll take it from you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll head to the community center parking lot by the side entrance. Thanks for the clear directions.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have they set a date for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—I’d want to confirm the date before I say for sure. I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana—just let me know once you confirm the date.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help gather spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools people can lend? That would make the repair drive run a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll start collecting spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend. I’ll bring what I gather over soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout — is there anything they still need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’m not sure—I might’ve missed the latest update. I’d check with whoever’s organizing it; they’d know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll ask around and see who’s organizing it. Hopefully they still need a few things I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on today — folks are meeting up later to help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to make sure — thanks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is moving along nicely—people have really been pitching in. I’m happy to help spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Ira. I appreciate you helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—I’ll keep mentioning it to folks I see today. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to tell people.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren. I’ll send you the details and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate that. I’ll keep an eye out for your message and jump in where I can.
